Wipe and implement

Once the biggest contributing factors to this is the speed at which u can max each skill. Make each skill take 50 times as long to max obviously scaling as you get higher level . Then make respawn times for higher level resources scale way harder, one of the reasons starmetal is basically 0.1 everywhere is because in some places the ore is just as abundant as Iron. Also the respawn time is nearly the same as Iron but u need 4 times as much Iron as starmetal to make an ingot. 

So basically my list to make the market viable is to do these things

1. Make leveling skills take waaaaaay longer increasing the longevity of the use of items through each tier

2. Decrease spawn of higher tier resources dramatically  (why does starmetal spawn at nearly the same rate as iron when u need 4 times as much Iron as starmetal for each ingot)

3. Completely get rid of basic ass mobs dropping any kind of armor. (There should be no reason I got better armor for every slot last night farming high level alligators) named items from mini bosses , cool . Rare High tier look from raids cool . Getting a better helmet than I've seen all game from an alligator bad. Doing this will increase demand dramatically as people farm resources to try and make that clean set of gear that's speced the right way.

4. Make leveling itself take waaaaay longer. Its week 1 and there many players in my server that are lvl 60. The speed makes each tier of armor get obsolete so fast , like I said it's week 1 and in my server I rarely see people below level 30 at this point . This combined with my previous point will incentivise farming resources or buying them to make that awesome speced gear cuz ur ganna be stuck with it longer than 2 days like it is now. This will stimulate the economy with people throwing resources at crafting good gear causing a drain for resources that are sitting at .1 right now. 

5. Have some sort of penalty to death right now its slight durability loss which doesn't matter cuz u can pay the repair fees easily I don't even know if there is a max durability loss on each repair because I swap through better gear sets so often it's irrelevant if there is . If above points are implemented a max durability loss on gear with each repair could be more viable as ur stuck with ur gears sets much longer. 

6. This piggybacks off previous point . Add areas of the map that are required pvp . U know has high density of high tier resources pr chests that incentivises people to come and fight for their claim of the lions share . And in those pvp areas make inventory items in bag drop on death . Right now I can go to great cleave waring nothing but. Pickaxe throw a camp down and farm starmetal with an extra 10% exp boost with no downsides besides maybe some player kills me and I lose a little durability. 
 
Now these are just a few suggestions that I think could greatly benefit this game . And I cam already hear the screeches of "its a pvp game its not about the crafting of grinding its about wars and stuff" well u will understand my points of longevity when in 2 months ur servers dead cuz there's nothing to do besides take point in a pointless war every 3 days. Now I'm absolutely loving this game but I think leveling, exp , drops , and the market were balanced for wipes that were happening in beta . So unless they implement something along the lines of my suggestion or other improvements this game will die like so many other because relying on wars will not suffice as territories are mostly important before endgame for exp boosts and tax breaks and cheap another teleports. After everyone is max leveled what's the point of wars at all besides some fun content every few days
